description: Check a pre-registered analysis plan for completeness and internal consistency before data is collected: the registration identifier, primary outcome, sample size, alpha, power, randomisation, blinding, analysis population, missing-data handling and statistical method, plus uncontrolled multiplicity when several endpoints are named. Before data collection, to catch a plan that is incomplete or internally inconsistent. Do not choose this when you need the power calculation verified against an effect size, which needs the numbers. Example requests: Check my statistical analysis plan before I collect data. | Does my analysis plan state power, alpha and the multiplicity adjustment? | What is missing from this pre-registered analysis plan? | Run a statistical analysis plan check over this protocol.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

analysis_plan.description: The customer's analysis-plan.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text or Markdown. The statistical analysis plan text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_statistics_plan_checker

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Statistical analysis plan checker
